title: Power Rankings: Miami Heat rise to No. 1
heading: 2010-11 Power Rankings: Week 11
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: The Heat have lost just once in their last 22 games ... and once in the last 43 days to be as precise as possible. So it seems safe to suggest that the Heatles, if nothing else, have at least figured out regular-season basketball.

rankings.summaryHtml: The Spurs, even with a two-game stumble in New York and Boston, were the first team in the league to win 30 games for the first time in franchise history. They're also the healthiest title contender going ... for a change.

rankings.summaryHtml: Most interesting element of the Magic's nine straight wins by eight points or more? They've averaged 16.1 fast-break points in those wins. In its first 28 games, Orlando was the league's worst running team at 7.9 ppg.
